description: Lightweight 8-feature LAN scan inference model. Combined training on CIC-IoT-2023 (class-balanced sampling) and UNSW-NB15 (full training set), mapping each dataset's binary service/protocol flags and categorical service/proto columns to LAN scan semantic proxy features. No synthetic data. Labels are each dataset's original 0/1. Metrics use one random_state=7 row-level 80/20 holdout and are not field accuracy. The full 42~46 feature traffic models in ../{unsw-nb15,ton-iot,cic-iot-2023}/ are kept for academic F1 metrics and future traffic-capture extension (RPi mode).

source.note: Trained on raw rows from CIC-IoT-2023 and UNSW-NB15 restricted to attack categories selected as LAN-related proxies (port scans, vulnerability scans, ARP/DNS spoofing, brute-force, backdoor/exploit traffic). DDoS/DoS/Mirai flood categories are intentionally excluded — they require traffic capture (RPi extension track) and are not represented by this LAN-scan proxy model. This offline holdout is not field accuracy or evidence that every network device is detectable.
